# SHEMIRANI Jewelry

> Fine jewellery designed and made by Abbas Shemirani — custom 18K gold and diamond rings,
> hand- and computer-designed and released in strictly limited editions. Based in Karaj, Iran;
> serving clients in Iran and three other countries.

Abbas Shemirani has 7+ years of experience in jewellery ideation, hand and CAD design, and gold
production, building on his father's 35 years in jewellery-making and stone-setting. He holds two
national and two international jewellery-design certificates and an entrepreneurship certificate.

## Designs
- [NNOR NOVELLE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/nnor-novelle/): NNOR NOVELLE is a filigree flower ring in 18K gold — a raised gold flower with layered petals, leaves and tiny beads; lattice openwork runs along both sides of the band; no stones.
- [NNOR AURELLE](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/nnor-aurelle/): NNOR AURELLE is a solitaire ring in 18K gold — a large round diamond held by four claws; small diamonds set along the shoulders, with beaded edges; 11 diamonds, 1.22 ct.
- [NNOR MIRAYA](https://shemiranijewelry.com/designs/nnor-miraya/): NNOR MIRAYA is a solitaire ring in 18K gold — a single round diamond held by four claws; twisting shoulders rise to the setting, with fine beaded edges; 1 diamond, 0.77 ct.

## Action figures
- [Action Figure](https://shemiranijewelry.com/collections/action-figures/)
- [CATBALL](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/catball/): CATBALL is a round-faced cat head sculpted in ZBrush — a watertight OBJ and STL file ready to 3D-print or cast, in any size, with its weight listed for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [CTHULHU](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/cthulhu/): CTHULHU is a chibi Cthulhu action figure with a tentacled face and bat-like wings, standing on its own rocky R'lyeh base — an STL file ready to 3D-print, cast in metal or paint, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [HELIX CHESS](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/chess-helix/): HELIX CHESS is a six-piece chess set with every piece twisted into an open spiral lattice — a watertight STL file ready to 3D-print or cast in metal, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [STAUNTON CHESS](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/chess-staunton/): STAUNTON CHESS is a classic six-piece Staunton chess set — pawn, rook, knight, bishop, queen and king — an STL file ready to 3D-print or cast in metal, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [MONOLITH CHESS](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/chess-monolith/): MONOLITH CHESS is a modern abstract six-piece chess set, each piece standing on a square base — an STL file ready to 3D-print or cast in metal, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [JOKER BUST](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/joker/): JOKER BUST is a grinning Joker bust in a wide-brimmed hat on a square plinth — a watertight STL file ready to 3D-print or cast in metal, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
- [WOLVERINE BUST](https://shemiranijewelry.com/figures/wolverine/): WOLVERINE BUST is a snarling Wolverine bust in horned cowl and battle armour on a carved plinth — an STL file ready to 3D-print or cast in metal, in any size, with weights for resin, filament, bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
